Apprehending his arrest, petitioner above-named has moved this Court for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Complaint (PCR) Case No.466 of 2021 registered under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 3 /4 of the D. P. Act.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that earlier anticipatory bail application of the petitioner was rejected solely on the ground the petitioner had failed to honour the term of settlement entered between both the sides as he had refused to take Opp. Party No.2 to the matrimonial home.
It is further submitted in this regard that at the relevant time, the petitioner fell ill and, therefore, he could not take her as per the terms of the settlement.
In support of the assertion, medical report has been filed.
Learned APP for the State assisted by learned counsel for the complainant has vehemently opposed the prayer.
It is submitted that the petitioner deliberately did not comply the earlier order.
Anticipatory bail on the basis of the settlement arrived in mediation was allowed.
There is no fresh ground to consider the anticipatory bail application.
The anticipatory bail application is cancelled and the petitioner is directed to surrender before the Court below within two weeks.
